Our client is an industrial company.

Jobomschrijving

• Assistance with year-end closing and reporting. Knowledge of both local GAAP and IFRS is required.
• Assistance with the Corporate Income Tax (CIT) calculation, with support from the Tax Manager.
• Handling audit requests for all companies within the audit scope (Belgium, the Netherlands, and Luxembourg - 3 companies in total).
• Reviewing the statutory financial statements for all companies within scope.
• Quarterly Board of Directors reporting, including the preparation of local GAAP trial balances (7 entities).

We are looking for a solid and experienced Financial Controller who has:

• Strong knowledge of taxation (Belgian corporate income tax and VAT).
• Good knowledge of local GAAP reporting requirements.
• IFRS knowledge is a strong advantage.
• Experience working in a multinational matrix organization.
• Familiarity with ERP systems (SAP is considered a plus).
• Strong general IT and financial software skills.
• Can work in Dutch and English.

To expand our team, we are currently looking for an experienced Azure Integration Architect with a passion for Azure & complex integration solutions. 

As part of CornerBriX, you'll join a community of pationated integration experts leading the enterprise integration space in Belgium. 

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? 

• Minimum bachelor's degree with at least 3 years of experience as an Azure Integration Architect
• Coding experience using .NET (Core)
• Knowledge and practical experience of/with Azure Integration Services, API Design & Azure Api Management 
• The Azure Identity management (AD, ADB2C,...) ecosystem has no secrets for you
• You have experience with working in an Agile way
• Knowledge and practical experience with Microservice oriented solutions, Docker and the Azure Kubernetes ecocsystem is a huge plus
• You are able to coach and guide your colleagues and our customers

• You have good English & Dutch communication skills

• You will assist our customers with architecture and design of high available, secure and scalable integration solutions using Azure Integration Services such as Logic Apps & Azure Functions
• It's important that you can assist our customers with architecture and design of API & Microservice solutions on Microsoft Azure 
• You will implement complex integration solutions with focus on availability, scalability and security 
• It's important that you stay up to date with the latest changes of the Azure ecosystem
• You don't mind getting your hands dirty and perform Development and DevOps tasks

FURTHERMORE, YOU ARE:

• Result oriented and self-motivated

• A good team player but able to work independently

With a strong expertise in IBM Integration Technology, Integration Designers specializes in designing, implementing and managing end-to-end software integration solutions using the IBM Hybrid Integration portfolio.

We design, implement and run small and large integration projects for various customers. We have experts in DataPower, IBM Integration, IBM MQ (including the Appliance), IBM API Connect etc. Our solutions play a key role in the digital information of companies.

What you will do:

As an IBM API consultant you will design, implement, test and document the API Management solutions. You're the first person to help our clients to easily make the switch to an API first way of working. This by defining robust microservices and hybrid cloud architectures.

Setting up the architecture and development process for customers starting with IBM API Connect, will be one of your responsibilities. By demonstrate new solutions and product capabilities, you'll keep our customers up to date with the latest improvements. You also get the chance to participate in pre-sales activities and to find new business opportunities.

What we expect from you:

• You have experience in the domain of IBM API Connect.
• You want to deepen and broaden your skills regarding API’s and micro services
• You have a broad interest in technology and corresponding new evolutions such as DevOps leveraging Kubernetes or Security with OpenID Connect
• You have good communication skills and are fluent in English and/or Dutch

In the ever-fascinating world of technology, integration opens endless possibilities. We are here to show companies how integration can empower their digital foundations and fuel business growth. And you have the chance to be at the forefront of the fascinating world of integration with us by joining us as an Integration Engineer.

Who are we?

Meet i8c! An established value within the integration market and part of CornerBriX, the largest integration community in Belgium. i8c is an expert in Hybrid Integration Platforms (HIP), ensuring seamless collaboration between all IT-systems like mobile apps, administrative tools, CRMs, ERPs, Microservices, SaaS platforms, B2B platforms and many more for leading companies in the BeNeLux region.

At i8c, you’ll find a community of integration experts who are here to challenge you, inspire you and support you. You'll always have the freedom to choose your work location, be it at home or one of our remote co-working spaces.

What will your job look like as an Integration Engineer at i8c:

• Take end-to-end ownership for i8c projects, handling development, deployment, and operational maintenance.
• You’ll embrace DevOps principles to achieve optimal uptime and minimize incidents. 
• You’ll learn to master multiple Hybrid Integration Platform (HIP) vendor solutions (IMB, Microsoft, Software AG, TIBCO, Google, Boomi…) establishing new standards and best practices.
• You’ll provide support on a rotational basis as part of a 24/7 standby team, ensuring prompt assistance when required.
• You’ll participate in daily standup meetings 

Who is our i8c Integration Engineer:

• We don't require extensive experience, but eagerness to deep dive into multiple hybrid integration platforms and technologies, such as Software AG webMethods, Tibco Connect, IBM App Connect/API Connect, Microsoft BizTalk and Azure, Google Apigee, and Boomi.
• You are fluent in English, both written as oral.
• You have basic programming experience with Java or .Net, with a focus on back-end development. 
• You are familiar with the concepts and principles of networking, security (DNS, firewalls, HTTP, SSL…) and DevOps (CI/CD, testing…)
• Knowledge of Enterprise Integration Patterns is a plus, just as experience with collaboration tools such as Atlassian, GitLab,…

In your role as a Data Engineer you provide insights and solutions for complex data problems in order to implement end-to-end data solutions. You are responsible for the implementation and maintenance of the Data Warehouse and ETL infrastructure, where you will transform data into useful data formats for analysis. As a Data Engineer you will come across many varied and challenging projects: ranging from the design and implementation of the data warehouse and the development of ETL to the implementation and maintenance of reports and dashboards.

WHO ARE YOU?

• You understand the needs of the customer and can easily handle complex data environments.
• You are focused on collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement.
• You have strong communication skills and always strive for the best solution.
• You have an inquisitive mind and eager to learn.
• You are fluent in Dutch or French and have a strong knowledge of English.

WHAT ABOUT YOUR TECHNICAL SKILLS?

• Knowledge and hands-on experience with ETL and Data pipelines to integrate multiple data sources
• Experience with Data Warehouse environments
• Insights in setting up ETL processes and Data Flows
• Development and testing of ETL jobs
• Solid programming skills and SQL querying experience
• Hands-on experience with ETL tools is a plus
• Knowledge of Data Vault, Kimball is a plus
• Knowledge of Oracle, Google BigQuery or Microsoft Azure is a plus

We are looking for a Customer Service Specialist to join an international and innovative organization. In this role, you will combine customer focus, analytical skills, and digital tools to ensure a smooth and proactive customer experience. Your main focus will be on managing customer orders, following up on quotations, and building long-term customer relationships.

Client Details

Our client is an internationally renowned industrial organization and market leader in innovative technical solutions for customers across Europe, the Middle East and Africa. 

Description

We are looking for a Customer Service Specialist to join an international and innovative organization. In this role, you will combine customer focus, analytical skills, and digital tools to ensure a smooth and proactive customer experience. Your main focus will be on managing customer orders, following up on quotations, and building long-term customer relationships.

 

Key Responsibilities

• Proactively manage and monitor the order portfolio.
• Anticipate potential issues and provide timely solutions to customers.
• Follow up on quotations and contribute to optimal conversion rates.
• Analyze customer data through dashboards and digital tools to determine priorities.
• Deliver personalized and high-quality customer service tailored to different customer segments.
• Collaborate closely with internal departments such as Sales, Supply Chain, and Operations to ensure an excellent customer experience.
• Actively contribute to process improvement and digitalization initiatives.
• Work with KPIs and data to continuously optimize service performance.
 

Your Profile

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience.
• Initial experience in customer service, sales support, customer experience, or a similar role.
• Strong communication skills in Dutch and English. Knowledge of French is an advantage.
• Analytical mindset and comfortable working with digital tools and MS Office.
• Customer-oriented, structured, and solution-driven.
• Proactive attitude with the ability to take initiative and think alongside customers and colleagues.
• Comfortable working in an environment where change, innovation, and continuous improvement are key priorities.

Our client operates in the logistics sector, specializing in warehouse operations and inventory management. The company focuses on the efficient handling, storage and distribution of goods. Quality, accuracy and safety are essential in its daily operations. Employees work together to ensure smooth inbound and outbound processes. You will join a professional warehouse environment where teamwork and efficiency are key.
Jobomschrijving

Looking for an opportunity where you can make a visible impact and help shape a growing operation from the ground up? Our client Segex is a new and expanding logistics organization based in Wommelgem, specializing in the storage, packaging, and distribution of healthcare and pharmaceutical products.

As part of an international group this company manages the flow of products from global manufacturers to customers across Central- and South- America, Europe and Asia. The Belgian operation was launched recently and currently employs a small team of around eight people, creating a unique opportunity to join a business in an exciting growth phase.

As Warehouse Supervisor, you will take ownership of the day-to-day warehouse operations and lead the Belgian warehouse team. You will play a key role in ensuring operational excellence while helping build processes and structure within a growing organization.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and coordinate the warehouse team, ensuring smooth daily operations.
• Manage inbound, outbound, picking, packing, inventory, and stock accuracy activities.
• Monitor warehouse KPIs and identify opportunities for operational improvement.
• Act as the local key user for the Warehouse Management System (WMS).
• Coordinate staffing, holidays, absences, and workforce planning in collaboration with local management.
• Ensure compliance with quality, safety, and operational procedures.
• Work closely with the international operations team in headquarters and support the continued growth of the Belgian site.

You enjoy being present on the warehouse floor, taking ownership, and motivating people to achieve operational goals.

Who You Are?

• A natural team leader who leads by example and communicates clearly.
• Structured, hands-on, and solution-oriented.
• Comfortable working in a dynamic international logistics environment.
• Focused on quality, efficiency, and continuous improvement.
• Proactive and capable of making operational decisions independently.
must haves

• Minimum 3 years of experience within warehouse or logistics operations.
• Proven experience as a Warehouse Supervisor, Team Leader, or Warehouse Coordinator.
• Experience managing and motivating operational teams.
• Strong understanding of inbound, outbound, inventory management, and warehouse KPIs.
• Hands-on experience with a Warehouse Management System (WMS).
• Good knowledge of international logistics and imported goods flows.
• Professional proficiency in English and Spanish. Knowledge of Dutch is considered a strong asset

jobs.description:
Deluge is seeking a creative and hands-on Content Creator to strengthen our brand presence and tell our story across digital channels. 
 

 As our Content Creator, you will:
 
 

• Develop and execute the content strategy for Deluge across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and other platforms. 

• Create and edit high-quality photo and video content for campaigns, product launches, and day-to-day storytelling. 

• Coordinate and manage content creation for digital platforms, newsletters, PR, and print materials. 

• Collaborate with external parties to create high-end content. 

• Collaborate closely with the founders to ensure all content aligns with Deluge’s tone, values, and aesthetic. 

• Monitor trends and translate them into creative concepts for luxury audiences. 

• Manage and plan the content calendar and publish posts consistently. 

• Create website visuals, and other marketing materials, such as newsletters. 

• Support influencer collaborations and event coverage. 

• Prepare shoots for upcoming campaigns. 

•  Organize and promote events, brand activations, and partnerships. 
 

• You have at least 3-5 years of experience in content creation, social media, or digital marketing -ideally within the beauty, fashion, or lifestyle industry. You have experience with Shopify and e-commerce. 

• You have a strong sense of visual storytelling, branding, and aesthetics. 

• You’re skilled in photography, videography, and editing tools. 

• You understand social media trends and know how to adapt them to a luxury brand voice. 

•  You have experience managing social media, newsletters, and website content. 

• You’re proactive, detail-oriented, and full of ideas. 

• You’re fluent in Dutch, French, and English. 

• You understand influencer marketing and community building. 

• You have a deep passion for beauty, design, and lifestyle experiences.
